name: Olive fiber + terracotta pulp | mobile terrain derivative v5
source: User-provided Olive Fiber texture set. Base color, normal and roughness structure are retained; the sphere render is never used as a texture.
derivation: Deterministic 2048px user texture downsampled to 1024px with Lanczos; top color receives a restrained warm lift. Dirt color is a luminance-preserving terracotta remap of the same layered pulp. Normal vectors are renormalized after resize; ORM remains linear and metalness is zero.
usage: Olive maps for grass tops and exposed pulp lip; dirt maps for cube sides/bottom. World-space UVs; no baked lighting.

textures.role: sRGB olive layered pulp top base color
linear OpenGL +Y source pulp flake normal
sRGB terracotta remap of layered pulp dirt base color
